name: extract and persist the integer part of the objective
definition: isolate the truncation of the reported objective and write exactly a single number to the output file.
failure_mode: extra whitespace/newline or a float-valued value fails exact-match

name: fetch and parse HTML from a remote server
definition: Make an HTTP GET to a server and parse the returned HTML document into a traversable structure.
failure_mode: Fetch fails or HTML not parsed, so no records are collected.
